featured_reviews.name: Denny Samson
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am genuinely disappointed to share this experience. Even after making a donation, I continue to receive messages and WhatsApp calls almost every single day, which is simply not acceptable. I understand that charitable institutions work with good intentions and aim to serve the needy, but the approach taken to request further donations is extremely irritating, and frankly, disheartening.

What concerns me even more is that the moment I donate to one institution (Ashray for Life), another institution (Being Sevak Trust) starts contacting me within minutes. This gives the impression that multiple organizations are somehow linked or sharing donor information. On top of that, they seem to use several different mobile numbers to reach out, making the follow ups feel irritating.

I truly appreciate the work these organizations may be doing. However, PLEASE RESPECT PEOPLE’S INTERESTS AND BOUNDARIES. This kind of aggressive follow up can easily make donors feel uncomfortable and even question the legitimacy of the cause. I have personally received calls and messages from various unknown numbers, and because of this experience, I no longer feel encouraged to donate to any organization again.

I hope this feedback is taken seriously and leads to more respectful communication practices moving forward.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Hi .. my self Jyoti chile.. a mother of twin babies who were born on this 31st Aug 2024.. my babies are born in preterm and currently admitted in Surya Hospital -Santacruz west... the NICU of Surya hospital is rated as no 1 in entire Asia.  My babies are currently undergoing with extreme low birth weight, extreme prematurity (25+2 weeks) and respiratory distress. Infants are currently on mechanical ventilation support, IV fluids and IV antibiotics. Hospital has given us the cost estimation of 44 Lakshmi for 3 months tenure.
While we approaching others trust I came across Reachout Foundation..I can certainly vouch for the saying "We are just a Call away" or "one call make a huge diffrence"... as per the name the Charity itself stands for help... I Reached out Deepa Mondal mam over call explained her mh medical aid requiremnt and the very next day I met her with all required documents... immediately the same day by evening I recd a donation from this Charity.. .. for a moment I was relaxed and beleived tht we do have people who are ready to help without expecting any thing... I and my husband will be forever grateful to Reachout Foundation  and Deepa Mondal Mam for supporting us and our babies in our hard time .. God Bless the Foundation 🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏

name: ANIMEDH CHARITABLE TRUST
description:
ACT is a non-profit organization based in Mumbai, India. We pledge to ‘Act to make a difference’ to marginalized children, youth, women and vulnerable communities whose lives are bogged down by poverty or distress and who lack the opportunity to access their full potential, get education or generate income.

In India, women and children constitute more than 70% of the total population. But they remain marginalized, poor and socially excluded, especially in the weaker sections of our society. We are determined to reverse this social inequity. Our role as a civil society is to help fulfill their dreams of education, livelihood, inclusion, well-being and social justice.

featured_reviews.name: Bhaishree Jain
featured_reviews.review_text: Give India is a non profit organisation in India. It is an online donation platform and aims to channel and provide resources to credible non-governmental organisations across India. It helps donors channelize their contribution to various charity organisations of their choice. E.g. if one wanted to donate money or in kind towards environment protection, Give India shall identify multiple NGOs doing this and provide all details so that one could make an informed choice. Give India ensures that 90% of our donation reaches the beneficiaries while only 10% is used towards administrative costs - the lowest world-wide.

name: Spark-A-Change Foundation
description:
We are an 8-yr old Mumbai-based registered Not-for-Profit entity, providing programs providing educational and vocational opportunities to children and youth from underserved backgrounds through various in-school and after school programs.
We impact over 1500 beneficiaries through our programs :
1. Anviksha Early Education Program – collaborations with MPS schools to support early education in 22 BMC classrooms
2. Anviksha Community Preschool – a free quality preschool for early learners
3. Foundational Learning Program – a volunteer driven program for grades 1-7
4. Board Ready Program – an tutorial program for students of grades 8-12
5. Youth Empowerment Program – a mentoring and support program for college students

name: Samta Foundation
description:
Samta Foundation an NGO based in Mumbai, India working in the areas of Healthcare, Education, Prisoner transformation & Community Development. A permanent team of over 175 staff work in the Tribal & Rural areas of Maharashtra & Madhya Pradesh.

Primary focus area in Healthcare are Cataract Surgeries, Family Planning & Child Malnutrition. Education provides Computer Literacy, and Dress Designing & tailoring through partner Schools. The Foundation works with Maharashtra Prisons for Eye & Skin detection camps + provide complete treatment. It provides sanitary napkins to all prisons. Community development includes building waiting shelters at hospitals for poor. Highly subsidized accommodation & meals are provided to poor patients & relatives.

I managed Google Ads campaigns that generated significant business results for this organization. The work was delivered consistently and on time, and the campaigns directly contributed to their growth.

Despite this, payments were repeatedly delayed and eventually remained pending for several months, even after multiple follow-ups and assurances. Communication later became unresponsive.

This caused serious financial stress for me. I strongly advise anyone providing performance-based services to secure strict payment terms and avoid continuing work without timely settlements.
